metadata.description: Standalone Claude Code marketplace hosting the ai-ready plugin — audit codebases for AI-readiness, apply ROI-prioritized improvements, and run an autonomous maker→checker→deterministic-rubric verification loop, all in one plugin. Supports both multi-module and single-module (package-as-module) layouts. v0.2.0+: config-driven frontmatter-aware INDEX + lazy-load user/auto split. v0.3.0+: config rubric section makes scoring respect project reality (docs/design as ADR, springdoc as API contract, .claude hooks as verification gate). v0.4.0+: apply guards human-adopted docs (generators refuse to overwrite files lacking the auto-gen signature; per-doc diff-confirm loop). v0.4.2+: INDEX generation respects .gitignore — only tracked or unignored .md is indexed, so generated artifacts and .claude/commands no longer pollute INDEX; non-git dirs fall back to a full walk. v0.5.0+: apply maintains docs surgically — the doc-touching scripts gather facts only (--json, read-only) and the AI adds/updates just what changed while preserving human curation, instead of wholesale overwriting. v0.6.0+: the former loop-engine plugin is folded into ai-ready — /loop-run, /loop-review, /loop-lessons + loop-checker/loop-lesson-synthesizer agents + the _loop-engine scoring shell ship in the same plugin, so one install covers the whole audit→apply→verify cycle and the loop reads/appends the docs/ANTIPATTERNS.md that ai-ready writes. v0.8.0+: the loop-build skill adds multi-phase autonomous build-out — it wraps loop-run's checker+rubric verdict engine in an outer phase loop where the maker is a per-phase subagent (continued via SendMessage within a phase) so many phases build out unattended while the orchestrator stays coding-free. v0.8.1+: loop-build fail-loud-validates phases.json before the unattended traversal — a jq assertion rejects a malformed decomposition (empty/non-array .phases, missing name/steps/ac_cmd, or an out-of-enum status) with exit 65 so a corrupt spec halts for a human instead of silently mis-traversing. v0.8.2+: the loop skills and loop-checker recover findings via a deterministic orchestrator-named output file rather than scraping the checker's final chat message, since a background/unattended session never delivers a subagent's final text inline; loop-checker's no-write Bash rule gains one narrow carve-out (that single findings path only), the orchestrator clears the file before each spin, and a fail-loud guard rejects an empty/missing findings file instead of silently passing. v0.8.3+: wiring & context-hygiene batch — the freshness Stop hook is self-contained (the copied .sh locates freshness_check.py next to itself and audit copies the .py too, so a project-context hook no longer dies on unset CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT); convention-docs/knowledge-layer/LOCAL-rubric paths are passed to the checker and lesson-synthesizer IN THE PROMPT (env vars never reach subagents, so the old wiring silently degraded every checker to the no-convention-docs path); loop-run persists brake values and detected commands to a params.env re-derived at the top of every step (a fresh shell per Bash call was silently disarming the iteration/time brake) and counts gate-failure re-entries against the brake; loop-build scopes stall state and the gate counter per phase and enforces the per-phase history split by re-pointing params.env (a prior phase's floor no longer manufactures false STALLED verdicts); the re-derivation pointer is per-branch (.active-{branch}) so an interleaved second loop cannot hijack a paused loop's state, params.env is sourced with set -a so LOCAL-rubric env reaches the scoring child processes, and the gate-failure counter increments self-contained from its file and codifies orchestrator context hygiene (never read findings/evidence prose inline — score summaries only, hand the maker the scored-file path instead of pasting findings, update phases.json via jq not Read/Edit, and prefer starting loop-build in a fresh session after design); decide/stall fail-loud-validate their input contracts; npm's default test stub is not adopted as a gate; loop-review detects the base branch before diffing and isolates its findings file per branch; the BASE rubric's security narrowing to IDOR-only is re-labeled as a c8c-api LOCAL decision (BASE stays broad). v0.8.4+: loop-checker and loop-lesson-synthesizer no longer pin model: opus in frontmatter — they inherit the calling session's model by default, overridable per invocation via the Agent tool's model param. v0.8.5+: loop-build's maker becomes a dedicated loop-maker agent whose frontmatter sets model: opus as a default tier below the session model (production work intentionally downgraded while the checker inherits the session model as the quality gate); the Agent call's model param still overrides per phase. v0.8.6+: loop-build's PASS branch makes maker termination explicit — the orchestrator sends a final 'phase done — terminate' SendMessage and never re-enters that maker, and loop-maker ends its turn on that notice; passed-phase makers no longer linger as waiting teammates.

plugins.name: ai-ready
plugins.description: Audit codebases for AI-readiness using a 7-category 100-point rubric, then apply ROI-prioritized improvements (CLAUDE.md scaffolds, ANTIPATTERNS.md seeds, INDEX.md, ARCHITECTURE.md Mermaid diagrams, freshness Stop hook, trend sparkline). Multi-module and single-module (package-as-module) layouts are scored on parallel rubrics. v0.2.0+: optional .ai-ready/config.json drives frontmatter-aware INDEX grouping and preserves user-edited lazy-load triggers. v0.3.0+: the config rubric section makes scoring respect project reality — docs/design counts as ADR, springdoc as API contract, project-level .claude/settings.json lint/test hooks as a verification gate. v0.4.0+: apply guards human-adopted docs — generators refuse to overwrite files lacking the auto-generated signature (--force to override) and apply runs a per-doc diff-confirm loop. v0.4.2+: INDEX generation respects .gitignore — only tracked or unignored .md is indexed, so generated artifacts and .claude/commands no longer pollute INDEX; non-git dirs fall back to a full walk. v0.5.0+: apply maintains docs surgically — the doc-touching scripts (gen_index, gen_arch_diagram, extract_section, inject_module_map, inject_lazy_load_index) gain a --json facts-only mode and the AI adds/updates only what changed while preserving human curation, instead of mechanically overwriting whole docs. v0.6.0+: the autonomous verification loop (formerly the separate loop-engine plugin) is folded in — /loop-run (maker→checker→deterministic-rubric→decide→stall loop until pass or brake), /loop-review (one-shot adversarial check), /loop-lessons (human-approved harvest of caught mistakes into the knowledge layer), the loop-checker and loop-lesson-synthesizer subagents, and the _loop-engine scoring shell (severity assigned by the shell, not the LLM; BASE rubric + optional project-local .loop/rubric.md). Build/test/lint commands, ticket pattern and base branch are runtime-detected (detect_build.py) so no adapter file is persisted; the loop's knowledge layer is the docs/ANTIPATTERNS.md that ai-ready writes, which the loop reads and appends to. v0.8.0+: the loop-build skill adds multi-phase autonomous build-out — loop-run's verdict engine wrapped in an outer phase loop with a per-phase subagent maker (SendMessage-continued within a phase) so many phases build out unattended. v0.8.1+: loop-build fail-loud-validates phases.json before the unattended traversal — a jq assertion rejects a malformed decomposition (empty/non-array .phases, missing name/steps/ac_cmd, or an out-of-enum status) with exit 65 so a corrupt spec halts for a human instead of silently mis-traversing. v0.8.2+: the loop skills (loop-run/loop-build/loop-review) and loop-checker recover findings via a deterministic orchestrator-named output file rather than scraping the checker's final chat message — a background/unattended session never delivers a subagent's final text inline, so file recovery is the only mode-agnostic path; loop-checker's no-write Bash rule gains one narrow carve-out (write only that single findings JSON path, refuse if it points at a source file), the orchestrator clears the file before each spin so a stale prior-cycle result can't masquerade as a pass, and a fail-loud [ -s ] guard rejects an empty/missing findings file instead of silently passing. v0.8.3+: wiring & context-hygiene batch — the freshness Stop hook is self-contained (the copied .sh locates freshness_check.py next to itself and audit copies the .py too, so a project-context hook no longer dies on unset CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT);
